blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Bookkeeping is the daily work of keeping the accounts up to date. The bookkeeper records every sale, every bill, every payment, and every receipt. They do it the moment it happens, or as close to that as possible.

At the end of the day, week, or month, the books are checked. The bookkeeper reconciles them with the bank and then closes them. It sounds quiet. That is the point.

Good bookkeeping is boring work done carefully. So when the leaders need a number, it is already clean and ready. The quietest bookkeepers are usually the best ones.

items.q: When does the bookkeeper record a sale or a bill?
options: The moment it happens, or as close as possible
Only at the end of the year
items.why: "They do it the moment it happens, or as close to that as possible."

items.q: What does the bookkeeper do at the end of the day, week, or month?
options: Check the books, reconcile with the bank, and close them
items.why: "the books are checked… reconciles them with the bank and then closes them."

items.q: Why is the number "clean and ready" when a leader asks?
options: Because it is a lucky guess
Because the work is done carefully every day
Because a computer does it alone
items.why: "Good bookkeeping is boring work done carefully. So when the leaders need a number, it is already clean and ready."

items.q: The text says "It sounds quiet. That is the point." The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: Bookkeeping should be exciting and dramatic
Records should be up to date
The bank should match the books
Quiet, careful work is good bookkeeping
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza o trabalho silencioso e cuidadoso, não o dramático.

items.q: "The quietest bookkeepers are usually the best ones" suggests that…
options: Good work does not cause problems or noise
items.why: Inferência: quando o trabalho é bem feito, não há erros nem confusão — fica "silencioso".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily explicando a rotina de fim de dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come sit with me. This is the end of the day, so I will show you our routine. We do the same thing every day. It is simple, but you must do it carefully.

First, I look at my list. Did I record every sale today? Every bill, every payment, every receipt? If one is missing, I add it now. I never leave it for tomorrow.

Next, I reconcile. That means I check that our books match the bank. I open the bank page and I compare the numbers. Today they match, so that is good. When they do not match, I stop and I find the reason before I go home.

Then I close the books for the day. All the entries are finished, so nothing is open.

And then? Then I walk out. That is it. It is quiet work, and quiet is good. If a leader asks me for a number tomorrow, it is already clean and ready.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the FIRST thing Emily does?
options: She checks that she recorded every sale, bill, payment, and receipt
items.why: "First, I look at my list. Did I record every sale today?"

items.q: What does "reconcile" mean in Emily's routine?
options: Check that the books match the bank
items.why: "I reconcile. That means I check that our books match the bank."

items.q: What does Emily do if the numbers do NOT match?
options: She stops and finds the reason before she goes home
She goes home and checks tomorrow
items.why: "When they do not match, I stop and I find the reason before I go home."

items.q: Why does Emily say "quiet is good"?
options: Because quiet means the work is done right and nothing is open
Because she does not like talking
items.why: Inferência: trabalho silencioso, sem problemas, é sinal de que tudo está em ordem.

items.q: How would you best describe Emily's routine?
options: Simple, but done carefully every day
items.why: Inferência: ela mesma diz "It is simple, but you must do it carefully" e repete os mesmos passos todo dia.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please keep the accounts up to date." Up to date means…
items.why: Up to date = em dia, sem nada faltando.

items.q: "I keep every receipt in a folder." A receipt is…
options: a paper that shows a payment was made
items.why: Receipt = recibo, o papel que prova o pagamento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At the end of the day, I ___ the books with the bank."
items.why: To reconcile = conciliar: conferir que os livros batem com o banco.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "All the entries are finished, so I ___ the books for today."
items.why: To close the books = fechar os livros: encerrar os lançamentos do período.

items.q: "It is boring work, but it is important." Boring means…
items.why: Boring = entediante, pouco emocionante — mas aqui é algo positivo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no trabalho diário do escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "Let's catch up on last week's entries." To catch up means to…
items.why: Catch up = colocar em dia o que estava atrasado.

items.q: "I will go over the numbers one more time." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, examinar com cuidado.

items.q: "Please fill in this form with the payment details." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações.

items.q: "She always follows through on her tasks." This means she…
items.why: Follow through = levar a tarefa até o fim.
